Special fire-protection sprinklers and nozzles

Closed-Type Centrifugal Fire Sprinklers

Closed-type pendent sprinklers with a 5 mm glass bulb and centrifugal distribution structure. The series offers six nominal metric K-factor options with BSPT male threads.

K90 / K115 / K145 / K155 / K175 / K200 metric
